meta.description: Data-abstraction knowledge: numeric limits that turn raw measurements into qualitative facts with a certainty factor. Each block names its knowledge source. Values marked 'assumed' are typical OEM/industry figures adopted by the team and are configurable per site.

iso10816_3.source: S-ISO10816 via S-FAB-ISO (zone boundaries, mm/s RMS)

pump.source: S-HI961 (NPSH margin concept; ratios assumed), S-PSG; operating window 70–120 % BEP assumed

motor.source: S-NEMA/S-PS (voltage unbalance), S-ECM (±10 % voltage), S-IEEE43 (IR ≥ 5 MΩ, PI ≥ 2.0), S-FAB-BRB (sideband bands); current-unbalance and load bands assumed

ai4i.source: S-AI4I / S-MATZKA (failure-mode definitions of the AI4I 2020 dataset)

apu.source: S-METROPT3 (8.2 bar cut-in, 7 bar LPS); duty, current and oil limits from the Feb–Jun normal-operation data (95th/99th percentiles) and S-EXPERT
